```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(tidytext)
load("dane/imiona_df.Rda")
imiona <- imiona_df
```

```{r}
imiona %>% 
  group_by(imie) %>% 
  summarise(ile = sum(liczba)) %>% 
  slice_max(ile, n = 15) %>% 
  mutate(imie = fct_reorder(imie, ile)) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(ile, imie)) +
  geom_col()
```

```{r}
p <- imiona %>% 
  filter(between(rok, 2005, 2015)) %>% 
  group_by(rok, plec, imie) %>% 
  summarise(ile = sum(liczba)) %>% 
  slice_max(ile, n = 3) %>% 
  mutate(imie = reorder_within(imie, ile, rok)) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(ile, imie, fill = plec)) +
  geom_col() + 
  geom_text(aes(label = ile), hjust = 1.15, size = 2.5, fontface = "bold", colour = "white") +
  facet_wrap(~ rok, ncol = 3, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(title = "Najpopularniejsze imiona w Warszawie", 
       subtitle = "w latach 2005-2015",
       x = "",
       y = "") +
  scale_fill_manual(name = "", 
                    values = c("K" = "#F472B6", "M" = "#60A5FA"), 
                    labels = c("K" = "Dziewczynki", "M" = "Chłopcy")) +
  scale_y_reordered() +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0,0)) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "top",
        plot.title = element_text(size = 12, hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10, hjust = 0.5, face = "italic"),
        axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        panel.grid = element_blank(),
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"))

ggsave(filename = "wykres1.png", 
       plot = p,
       path = "wykresy/",
       units = "cm",
       height = 20,
       dpi = 300)

p
```

```{r}
a <- imiona %>% 
  filter(between(rok, 2005, 2015)) %>% 
  group_by(rok, plec, imie) %>% 
  summarise(ile = sum(liczba)) %>% 
  slice_max(ile, n = 3) %>% 
  mutate(font = ifelse(ile == max(ile), "bold", "plain"))

q <- a %>% 
  ungroup(plec) %>% 
  mutate(numer = row_number()) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(numer_wiersza = row_number()) %>% 
  mutate(imie = reorder_within(imie, rev(numer), rok)) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(ile, imie, fill = plec)) +
  geom_col() + 
  geom_text(aes(label = ile), hjust = 1.15, size = 2.5, fontface = "bold", colour = "white") +
  facet_wrap(~ rok, ncol = 3, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(title = "Najpopularniejsze imiona w Warszawie", 
       subtitle = "w latach 2005-2015",
       x = "",
       y = "") +
  scale_fill_manual(name = "", 
                    values = c("K" = "#F472B6", "M" = "#60A5FA"), 
                    labels = c("K" = "Dziewczynki", "M" = "Chłopcy")) +
  scale_y_reordered() +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0,0)) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "top",
        plot.title = element_text(size = 12, hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10, hjust = 0.5, face = "italic"),
        axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        panel.grid = element_blank(),
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
        axis.text.y = element_text(face = a$font))

ggsave(filename = "wykres2.png", 
       plot = q,
       path = "wykresy/",
       units = "cm",
       height = 20,
       dpi = 300)

q
```

```{r}
imiona %>% 
  filter(between(rok, 2005, 2015)) %>% 
  group_by(rok, plec) %>% 
  summarise(ile = sum(liczba)) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(rok, ile)) + 
  geom_col(fill = "grey60") +
  geom_col(aes(fill = plec), position = "dodge", width = 0.7) + 
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
imiona %>% 
  filter(between(rok, 2005, 2015)) %>% 
  group_by(rok, plec) %>% 
  summarise(ile = sum(liczba)) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = plec, values_from = ile) %>% 
  mutate(roznica = M - K)
```
